purpose: Stable evaluation dimensions for AI-assisted development proposals.

dimensions.label: Correctness and stability
dimensions.goal: The playable loop behaves deterministically where intended and does not lose, duplicate, or corrupt player state.

dimensions.label: Tactical depth
dimensions.goal: Multiple viable approaches create meaningful positional and ability decisions instead of a single dominant line.

dimensions.label: Run health and replayability
dimensions.goal: Runs produce varied builds, understandable risk, recoverable setbacks, and reasons to make different choices.

dimensions.label: Readability and UX
dimensions.goal: Players can understand state, intent, targeting, consequences, and navigation without fighting the interface.

dimensions.label: Browser delivery and performance
dimensions.goal: The intended browser build starts reliably, remains responsive, and preserves the run lifecycle across supported browser sessions.

dimensions.label: Discovery and coverage
dimensions.goal: The development process continuously reduces important unknowns and turns escaped failures into durable checks.
